dialogue.en: Hello, what's your name?
My name is Aman.

dialogue.cz: Těší mě. Já jsem Jana Nováková. Odkud jste?
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Jana Nováková. Where are you from?

dialogue.cz: Těší mě. Jsem z Anglie, ale bydlím v Brně.
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. I'm from England, but I live in Brno.
Do you speak Czech?

dialogue.cz: Mluvím jen trochu česky. Učím se.
dialogue.en: I only speak a little Czech. I'm learning.

dialogue.cz: Mluvíte dobře! Jste tady s rodinou?
dialogue.en: You speak well! Are you here with your family?

dialogue.cz: Ano, jsem ženatý. Moje žena je taky tady.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm married. My wife is here too.
Great. Well, goodbye.
Goodbye.

phrases.en: How do you say ... in Czech?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, what is this?
That's a mug.
And how do you say "umbrella" in Czech?
Deštník. Here is an umbrella.
Is it your umbrella?
No, that's not my umbrella.
And this bag? Is it yours?

dialogue.cz: Ano, ta je moje. Je nová.
dialogue.en: Yes, that one is mine. It's new.

dialogue.cz: Je hezká. A kde je můj mobil?
dialogue.en: It's nice. And where's my phone?
Over there, on the table.

title: What time is it? (Kolik je hodin?)

dialogue.en: Excuse me, what time is it?
It's half past eight.

dialogue.cz: Děkuju. V kolik hodin otvírá pošta?
dialogue.en: Thanks. What time does the post office open?
At nine o'clock.
And today is Wednesday, right?
No, today is Thursday.
I see. Do you have time tomorrow afternoon?

dialogue.cz: Zítra mám čas od tří do pěti.
dialogue.en: Tomorrow I'm free from three to five.
Great. So tomorrow at four?
OK, at four. Goodbye.

phrases.en: What do you do at the weekend?
I get up at seven in the morning.

dialogue.en: Hi Aman, what are you doing?

dialogue.cz: Ahoj. Teď vařím večeři. A ty?
dialogue.en: Hi. I'm cooking dinner now. And you?

dialogue.cz: Já se dívám na film. Co děláš zítra?
dialogue.en: I'm watching a film. What are you doing tomorrow?

dialogue.cz: Ráno pracuju a odpoledne se učím česky.
dialogue.en: In the morning I work and in the afternoon I study Czech.
Where do you work?
I work in an office in the centre.
And what do you do at the weekend?

dialogue.cz: V sobotu nakupuju a v neděli odpočívám.
dialogue.en: On Saturday I shop and on Sunday I rest.
Do you want to play tennis on Sunday?
Yeah, I'd like that. What time?
At ten in the morning.
OK, see you on Sunday. Bye!

phrases.en: Can you write it down for me?
I speak only a little Czech.

dialogue.en: Hello?
Hello, this is Aman.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Promiňte, nerozumím. Kdo volá?
dialogue.en: Hello. Sorry, I didn't catch that. Who's calling?

dialogue.cz: Aman. Mluvím jen trochu česky. Můžete mluvit pomaleji?
dialogue.en: Aman. I speak only a little Czech. Can you speak more slowly?
Yes, of course. What do you need?
I need to speak with Mrs Nováková.

dialogue.cz: Paní Nováková tady teď není. Můžete zavolat zítra?
dialogue.en: Mrs Nováková isn't here now. Can you call tomorrow?
OK. What's her email?

dialogue.cz: novakova@firma.cz. Mám vám to poslat ve zprávě?
dialogue.en: novakova@firma.cz. Shall I send it to you in a message?
Yes, please, send me a message.
OK. Goodbye.
Thank you, goodbye.

phrases.cz: Mám jednoho syna a jednu dceru.
phrases.en: I have one son and one daughter.
Do you have a big family?

dialogue.en: Do you have a family?

dialogue.cz: Ano, jsem ženatý a mám dvě děti.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm married and I have two children.
Sons or daughters?

dialogue.cz: Mám syna a dceru. Synovi je osm let a dceři pět.
dialogue.en: I have a son and a daughter. My son is eight and my daughter five.
And where do your parents live?

dialogue.cz: Moji rodiče bydlí v Anglii. Bratr taky.
dialogue.en: My parents live in England. My brother too.
Do you have only one brother?

dialogue.cz: Ne, mám bratra a sestru. Sestra bydlí v Kanadě.
dialogue.en: No, I have a brother and a sister. My sister lives in Canada.
That's a big family!
Yes. And do you have children?

dialogue.cz: Ne, ještě ne. Ale mám psa.
dialogue.en: No, not yet. But I have a dog.
That's family too!

phrases.cz: Praha je hlavní město České republiky.
phrases.en: Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic.

phrases.cz: Bydlím v České republice tři roky.
phrases.en: I've been living in the Czech Republic for three years.
How long have you been in Czechia?
Do you know the Krkonoše mountains?
Český Krumlov is in the south.
The Czech Republic has fourteen regions.
Czechs drink a lot of beer.

dialogue.en: How long have you lived in Czechia?
I've lived here for three years.
And where do you live?
I live in Brno, in Moravia.
Do you like it here?

dialogue.cz: Ano, moc. Je to krásná země.
dialogue.en: Yes, very much. It's a beautiful country.
Do you know Prague?

dialogue.cz: Ano, Praha je krásná. Ale mám rád taky hory.
dialogue.en: Yes, Prague is beautiful. But I also like mountains.
Have you been to the Krkonoše mountains?
No, not yet. Where are they?

dialogue.cz: Na severu. Je tam Sněžka, nejvyšší hora.
dialogue.en: In the north. Sněžka, the highest mountain, is there.
Then I'll go there in summer.

phrases.en: I need to see a doctor.

dialogue.en: Hello, what's wrong?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Bolí mě hlava a v krku.
dialogue.en: Hello. I have a headache and a sore throat.
Do you have a fever?

dialogue.cz: Ano, včera večer jsem měl třicet osm.
dialogue.en: Yes, last night I had thirty-eight.
Do you also have a runny nose?
A little. And my back hurts.

dialogue.cz: Otevřete ústa, prosím. Krk je červený.
dialogue.en: Open your mouth, please. Your throat is red.
Is it serious?

dialogue.cz: Ne, je to chřipka. Musíte zůstat doma.
dialogue.en: No, it's flu. You have to stay at home.
How long?

dialogue.cz: Tři až pět dní. Pijte hodně čaje.
dialogue.en: Three to five days. Drink a lot of tea.
Thank you, goodbye.

phrases.en: What do you like to eat?

phrases.cz: K snídani jím rohlík s máslem.
phrases.en: For breakfast I eat a roll with butter.

dialogue.en: Aman, are you hungry?

dialogue.cz: Ano, mám velký hlad. Co je dnes k obědu?
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm very hungry. What's for lunch today?

dialogue.cz: Kuřecí polévka a řízek s bramborovým salátem.
dialogue.en: Chicken soup and schnitzel with potato salad.
Great, I like schnitzel.
Will you have a green salad too?
No, thanks. That's enough for me.
And what will you drink? Beer?

dialogue.cz: Ne, dnes jen vodu. Odpoledne pracuju.
dialogue.en: No, just water today. I'm working in the afternoon.
Well, enjoy your meal!

dialogue.cz: Děkuju, nápodobně. Moc mi to chutná.
dialogue.en: Thanks, you too. I really like it.

phrases.en: I'd like a kilo of apples.

phrases.cz: To je všechno. / To je vše.

dialogue.en: Hello, what would you like?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Chtěl bych chleba a čtyři rohlíky.
dialogue.en: Hello. I'd like bread and four rolls.
Anything else?

dialogue.cz: Ano, deset deka šunky a jeden jogurt.
dialogue.en: Yes, a hundred grams of ham and one yoghurt.
Plain or strawberry?
Plain, please. How much is it?
A hundred and twenty crowns altogether.
Can I pay by card?
Yes, of course. Do you want the receipt?
No, thanks. Goodbye.

title: Orientation in the city (Orientace ve městě)

phrases.en: Excuse me, where is the station?
How do I get to the square?

phrases.cz: Je to blízko, asi pět minut pěšky.
phrases.en: It's close, about five minutes on foot.
I'm looking for the tram stop.

phrases.cz: Můžete mi to ukázat na mapě?
phrases.en: Can you show me on the map?

dialogue.en: Excuse me, where's the post office here?
The post office? It's on Freedom Square.
Is it far?
No, about ten minutes on foot.
How do I get there?

dialogue.cz: Jděte rovně až ke kostelu. Tam zahněte doleva.
dialogue.en: Go straight on as far as the church. Turn left there.
Left at the church. And then?

dialogue.cz: Pak jděte pořád rovně. Pošta je vedle banky.
dialogue.en: Then keep going straight. The post office is next to the bank.

dialogue.cz: Můžete mi to ukázat na mapě?
dialogue.en: Can you show me on the map?

dialogue.cz: Jasně. Tady jsme my a tady je pošta.
dialogue.en: Sure. We're here and the post office is here.
Thank you very much.
You're welcome.

phrases.cz: Dobrý den, mám termín na deset hodin.
phrases.en: Hello, I have an appointment at ten.
I need to extend my residence permit.
Where can I get the form?
Which counter should I go to?
When can I collect the card?
Your passport is no longer valid.
I don't understand, can you say it another way?

dialogue.en: Hello, what do you need?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Chci podat žádost o trvalý pobyt.
dialogue.en: Hello. I want to apply for permanent residence.
Do you have an appointment?

dialogue.cz: Ano, na deset hodin. Tady je můj pas.
dialogue.en: Yes, at ten o'clock. Here's my passport.
Thank you. Do you have the completed form?

dialogue.cz: Ano, ale nevím, co mám napsat tady.
dialogue.en: Yes, but I don't know what to write here.

dialogue.cz: Tady napište adresu v České republice.
dialogue.en: Write your address in the Czech Republic here.
OK. Do you need a photo?

dialogue.cz: Ne, fotíme tady. Ještě potřebuju doklad o ubytování.
dialogue.en: No, we take the photo here. I also need proof of accommodation.
Here it is. How much is the fee?

dialogue.cz: Poplatek je dva tisíce pět set korun.
dialogue.en: The fee is two thousand five hundred crowns.
OK. And when will the decision be made?

phrases.cz: V kolik hodin jede vlak do Olomouce?
phrases.en: What time does the train to Olomouc leave?
How much is a seat reservation?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, jednu jízdenku do Prahy, prosím.
dialogue.en: Hello, one ticket to Prague, please.
One-way or return?
Return. I'm coming back on Sunday.
Do you have any discount?

dialogue.cz: Ne, nemám. V kolik jede další vlak?
dialogue.en: No, I don't. What time is the next train?

dialogue.cz: V deset dvacet z třetího nástupiště.
dialogue.en: At ten twenty from platform three.
Is it a direct train?
Yes, you don't have to change.
How much is it?
Four hundred and eighty crowns.
Here you are. Thank you.
Have a good trip!

phrases.en: I have a reservation under the name ...
Do you have a free room?
How much is a room per night?
The room is on the second floor.
Can I leave my suitcase here?

phrases.cz: Do kolika hodin musím uvolnit pokoj?
phrases.en: By what time do I have to check out?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, mám rezervaci na jméno Aman.
dialogue.en: Hello, I have a reservation under the name Aman.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Moment... Ano, dvoulůžkový pokoj na dvě noci.
dialogue.en: Hello. One moment... Yes, a double room for two nights.

dialogue.cz: Přesně tak. Je snídaně v ceně?
dialogue.en: Exactly. Is breakfast included?

dialogue.cz: Ano, snídaně je od sedmi do deseti v restauraci.
dialogue.en: Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant.

dialogue.cz: Výborně. Jaké je heslo na wifi?
dialogue.en: Great. What's the Wi-Fi password?

dialogue.cz: Heslo je na kartě. Tady je klíč, pokoj číslo dvě stě patnáct.
dialogue.en: The password is on the card. Here's the key, room two hundred and fifteen.
Is it on the second floor?
Yes, the lift is on the right.
Can I park here?

dialogue.cz: Ano, parkoviště je za hotelem. Stojí to dvě stě korun na noc.
dialogue.en: Yes, the car park is behind the hotel. It costs two hundred crowns a night.

dialogue.cz: Dobře. Do kolika musím uvolnit pokoj?
dialogue.en: OK. By when do I have to check out?
By eleven o'clock. Enjoy your stay!

phrases.en: Do you have a free table?
Do you have anything without meat?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, máte volný stůl pro dva?
dialogue.en: Hello, do you have a free table for two?

dialogue.cz: Ano, tady u okna. Co si dáte k pití?
dialogue.en: Yes, here by the window. What would you like to drink?

dialogue.cz: Jedno malé pivo a minerálku, prosím. Co nám doporučíte k jídlu?
dialogue.en: One small beer and a mineral water, please. What do you recommend to eat?
Today we have excellent svíčková.
Good, I'll have the svíčková.
And for the lady?
Vegetable risotto for my wife.
Fine. It'll be right up.
The bill, please. Together.

dialogue.cz: To dělá pět set čtyřicet korun.
dialogue.en: That's five hundred and forty crowns.
Make it five hundred and sixty.
Thank you, have a nice day.

phrases.cz: Do jaké školy chodí váš syn?
phrases.en: Which school does your son go to?

phrases.cz: Můj syn chodí do třetí třídy.
phrases.en: My son is in the third grade.
I want to enrol my daughter in kindergarten.
Do we have homework for tomorrow?
I got a one (the best mark).
Can I speak with the class teacher?

phrases.cz: Můj syn dnes nepřijde, je nemocný.
phrases.en: My son won't come today, he's ill.
I study for an hour every day.
Can you explain it to me?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, jsem paní Dvořáková, třídní učitelka.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm Mrs Dvořáková, the class teacher.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, já jsem Davidův táta. Těší mě.
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm David's dad. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.cz: Těší mě. David je dobrý žák.
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you. David is a good pupil.

dialogue.cz: To jsem rád. Jak mu jde čeština?
dialogue.en: I'm glad. How is he doing in Czech?
Well, but he needs to read more.

dialogue.cz: Rozumím. Doma budeme číst každý večer.
dialogue.en: I understand. We'll read every evening at home.

dialogue.cz: To je výborné. Zítra píšeme test z matematiky.
dialogue.en: That's great. Tomorrow we're writing a maths test.

dialogue.cz: Dobře, připraví se. Kdy jsou třídní schůzky?
dialogue.en: OK, he'll prepare. When is the parents' evening?
On Thursday at five o'clock.

dialogue.cz: Přijdu. A kdy začínají letní prázdniny?
dialogue.en: I'll come. And when do the summer holidays start?
On the first of July.
Thank you, goodbye.

phrases.en: I work in a big company.
I work from eight to four.
I'm looking for a new job.

phrases.cz: Chtěl bych se zeptat na plat.
phrases.en: I'd like to ask about the salary.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, posaďte se. Čím jste?
dialogue.en: Hello, take a seat. What do you do?

dialogue.cz: Jsem programátor. Pracuju v IT pět let.
dialogue.en: I'm a programmer. I've worked in IT for five years.
Where do you work now?

dialogue.cz: V malé firmě v Brně, ale hledám novou práci.
dialogue.en: In a small company in Brno, but I'm looking for a new job.
Why do you want to change jobs?

dialogue.cz: Chci pracovat ve větší firmě a víc mluvit česky.
dialogue.en: I want to work in a bigger company and speak more Czech.

dialogue.cz: Rozumím. Pracovní doba je od osmi do půl páté.
dialogue.en: I see. Working hours are from eight to half past four.
Can I sometimes work from home?
Yes, two days a week.

dialogue.cz: To je výborné. A jakou smlouvu nabízíte?
dialogue.en: That's great. And what contract do you offer?

dialogue.cz: Nejdřív na rok, potom na dobu neurčitou.
dialogue.en: First for a year, then permanent.
Thank you. When will I find out the result?

title: Interests and leisure time (Zájmy a volný čas)

phrases.en: What do you do in your free time?

phrases.cz: Rád čtu a chodím do kina.
phrases.en: I like reading and going to the cinema.
At weekends I ride my bike.

phrases.cz: Nechceš jít v sobotu na koncert?
phrases.en: Do you want to go to a concert on Saturday?
We go on trips into nature.

dialogue.cz: Amane, co děláš ve volném čase?
dialogue.en: Aman, what do you do in your free time?

dialogue.cz: Rád sportuju. Hraju tenis a chodím plavat.
dialogue.en: I like sport. I play tennis and go swimming.
Where do you go swimming?

dialogue.cz: Do bazénu blízko práce, dvakrát týdně.
dialogue.en: To a pool near work, twice a week.
I prefer hiking.

dialogue.cz: To je taky hezké. Kam chodíš?
dialogue.en: That's nice too. Where do you go?

dialogue.cz: Většinou do Moravského krasu. Nechceš jít v sobotu se mnou?
dialogue.en: Mostly to the Moravian Karst. Do you want to come with me on Saturday?
I'd love to. What time do we set off?
At eight in the morning from the station.

dialogue.cz: Dobře. Mám si vzít něco s sebou?
dialogue.en: OK. Should I bring anything?
Good shoes and a snack.
Sure. See you on Saturday!

phrases.en: Did you get my message? (to a woman)
Can you send me the link?
Shall we do a video call?

dialogue.en: Hi, did you get my email?

dialogue.cz: Ne, nic jsem nedostal. Kdy jsi ho poslala?
dialogue.en: No, I didn't get anything. When did you send it?

dialogue.cz: Včera večer. Byla tam příloha s fotkami.
dialogue.en: Last night. There was an attachment with photos.

dialogue.cz: Možná je ve spamu. Hned se podívám.
dialogue.en: Maybe it's in spam. I'll look right away.
Are you online now?

dialogue.cz: Ano, jsem na počítači, ale internet je dnes hrozně pomalý.
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm on the computer, but the internet is terribly slow today.

dialogue.cz: Tak ti pošlu odkaz na WhatsApp.
dialogue.en: Then I'll send you a link on WhatsApp.
OK. I've got it, thanks.
Does it work?

dialogue.cz: Ano, fotky se stahují. Jsou krásné!
dialogue.en: Yes, the photos are downloading. They're beautiful!
You can share them with your family.
I'll do that. Thanks!

phrases.en: I live in a flat in the centre.
We have a 2+1 flat (two rooms plus kitchen).
How much do you pay in rent?
The rent is fifteen thousand a month.
I'm looking for a flat to rent.
We live on the third floor.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, volám kvůli bytu k pronájmu. Je ještě volný?
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm calling about the flat for rent. Is it still available?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Ano, ještě je volný.
dialogue.en: Hello. Yes, it's still available.
How big is it?

dialogue.cz: Je to dva plus kk, padesát metrů, ve druhém patře.
dialogue.en: It's a 2+kk, fifty square metres, on the second floor.
Is it furnished?

dialogue.cz: Kuchyň je vybavená, je tam pračka a lednička.
dialogue.en: The kitchen is equipped, there's a washing machine and a fridge.
How much is the rent?

dialogue.cz: Čtrnáct tisíc plus energie, asi tři tisíce.
dialogue.en: Fourteen thousand plus utilities, about three thousand.
And how much is the deposit?

dialogue.cz: Dva nájmy. Chcete se přijít podívat?
dialogue.en: Two months' rent. Do you want to come and see it?
Yes. Can I come tomorrow after work?

dialogue.cz: V šest? Adresa je Kounicova dvacet.
dialogue.en: At six? The address is Kounicova twenty.

phrases.en: Which tram goes to the station?
Where can I buy a ticket?

phrases.cz: Jízdenku si můžete koupit v aplikaci.
phrases.en: You can buy a ticket in the app.
There's a traffic jam on the motorway.
You have to change to the metro.

dialogue.cz: Promiňte, jede tahle tramvaj na hlavní nádraží?
dialogue.en: Excuse me, does this tram go to the main station?

dialogue.cz: Ne, musíte jet čtyřkou nebo devítkou.
dialogue.en: No, you have to take the four or the nine.
And where do they leave from?
From the stop opposite.
How many stops is it?
About five stops, ten minutes.
Where can I buy a ticket?

dialogue.cz: V automatu na zastávce, nebo kartou přímo v tramvaji.
dialogue.en: From the machine at the stop, or by card right in the tram.
How much is a ticket?
I don't know exactly, about thirty crowns.
Thank you very much.

dialogue.cz: Není zač. A pozor, často tam jsou revizoři.
dialogue.en: You're welcome. And watch out, there are often inspectors.

phrases.cz: Záchranka má číslo sto padesát pět.

phrases.en: Do you have a first aid kit?
Where are you? What's the address?

dialogue.en: Emergency medical service, what happened?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, na ulici spadl starý pán.
dialogue.en: Hello, an old man has fallen in the street.
Is he conscious?

dialogue.cz: Ano, ale nemůže vstát a krvácí mu hlava.
dialogue.en: Yes, but he can't get up and his head is bleeding.
Is he breathing normally?
Yes, he's breathing.
What's the exact address?

dialogue.cz: Pekařská ulice, u čísla dvanáct, před lékárnou.
dialogue.en: Pekařská Street, by number twelve, in front of the pharmacy.

dialogue.cz: Sanitka už jede. Nehýbejte s ním.
dialogue.en: The ambulance is on its way. Don't move him.

dialogue.cz: Mám mu dát něco na hlavu?
dialogue.en: Should I put something on his head?

dialogue.cz: Ano, přitlačte na ránu čistou látku.
dialogue.en: Yes, press a clean cloth on the wound.
OK, I understand.

phrases.cz: Chtěl bych poslat balík do Anglie.
phrases.en: I'd like to send a parcel to England.
I'm going to pick up a parcel.
I'd like to open an account.

phrases.cz: Chtěl bych se objednat na stříhání.
phrases.en: I'd like to book a haircut.
I want to make a warranty claim.
Do you have a free slot on Thursday?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, nefunguje mi mobil. Můžete ho opravit?
dialogue.en: Hello, my phone doesn't work. Can you repair it?
Hello. What happened?

dialogue.cz: Spadl mi na zem a teď nejde zapnout.
dialogue.en: I dropped it on the floor and now it won't switch on.

dialogue.cz: Ukažte... Asi je to displej. Je ještě v záruce?
dialogue.en: Let me see... It's probably the display. Is it still under warranty?

dialogue.cz: Ano, koupil jsem ho před rokem. Tady je účtenka.
dialogue.en: Yes, I bought it a year ago. Here's the receipt.

dialogue.cz: Na pád se ale záruka nevztahuje.
dialogue.en: But the warranty doesn't cover a fall.
I see. How much will the repair cost?

dialogue.cz: Asi dva tisíce pět set korun.
dialogue.en: About two thousand five hundred crowns.
And when will it be ready?
By Friday. We'll call you.
OK. Here's my number.
Thank you. Goodbye.

phrases.en: According to the forecast there'll be a storm.

dialogue.cz: Ahoj, viděl jsi předpověď na víkend?
dialogue.en: Hi, have you seen the forecast for the weekend?
Not yet. What will the weather be like?

dialogue.cz: V sobotu bude hezky, asi dvacet pět stupňů.
dialogue.en: On Saturday it'll be nice, about twenty-five degrees.
Great! And on Sunday?

dialogue.cz: V neděli bude pršet a odpoledne možná bouřka.
dialogue.en: On Sunday it'll rain and maybe a storm in the afternoon.

dialogue.cz: Tak pojedeme na výlet v sobotu.
dialogue.en: Then we'll go on the trip on Saturday.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý nápad. Ale ráno bude ještě chladno.
dialogue.en: Good idea. But it'll still be chilly in the morning.
I'll take a jacket. Will it be windy?
A little, but not much.

dialogue.cz: Tak v sobotu v devět u mě?
dialogue.en: So Saturday at nine at my place?

dialogue.cz: Platí. A vezmi si krém na opalování.
dialogue.en: Deal. And bring sunscreen.
Sure, I won't forget.

phrases.en: Where are you going on holiday?

phrases.cz: Byl jsem u moře v Chorvatsku.
phrases.en: I was at the seaside in Croatia.
How did you spend your holiday? (to a man)

dialogue.cz: Ahoj Amane, kde jsi byl? Dlouho jsem tě neviděla.
dialogue.en: Hi Aman, where have you been? I haven't seen you for ages.

dialogue.cz: Ahoj! Byl jsem na dovolené v Chorvatsku.
dialogue.en: Hi! I was on holiday in Croatia.

dialogue.cz: Super! Jak dlouho jste tam byli?
dialogue.en: Great! How long were you there?

dialogue.cz: Deset dní. Byli jsme u moře s celou rodinou.
dialogue.en: Ten days. We were at the seaside with the whole family.
And what was the weather like?

dialogue.cz: Každý den svítilo slunce. Bylo asi třicet stupňů.
dialogue.en: The sun shone every day. It was about thirty degrees.
What did you do there?

dialogue.cz: Hlavně jsme se koupali a odpočívali. Děti si hrály na pláži.
dialogue.en: Mostly we swam and rested. The children played on the beach.

dialogue.cz: To zní krásně. Jeli jste autem?
dialogue.en: That sounds lovely. Did you go by car?

dialogue.cz: Ano, cesta trvala skoro deset hodin.
dialogue.en: Yes, the journey took almost ten hours.

dialogue.cz: Já pojedu v srpnu na hory.
dialogue.en: I'm going to the mountains in August.

dialogue.cz: Tak ať se ti tam líbí!
dialogue.en: Well, I hope you enjoy it there!

phrases.cz: Chtěl bych tě pozvat na oslavu.
phrases.en: I'd like to invite you to a party.
Should I take off my shoes?

dialogue.en: Hi Aman, come in!

dialogue.cz: Ahoj Petro. Všechno nejlepší k narozeninám! Tady je malý dárek.
dialogue.en: Hi Petra. Happy birthday! Here's a small present.

dialogue.cz: Děkuju, to jsi nemusel! A krásné květiny.
dialogue.en: Thank you, you shouldn't have! And beautiful flowers.
Should I take off my shoes?
If you like, here are some slippers.
Thanks. How many people are coming?

dialogue.cz: Asi deset. Dáš si víno, nebo pivo?
dialogue.en: About ten. Would you like wine or beer?
Wine, please.
Well, cheers!
Cheers! And to you!

dialogue.cz: Ochutnej ten dort, upekla ho moje máma.
dialogue.en: Try the cake, my mum baked it.
Mmm, it's delicious.

phrases.en: I have a health insurance card.
Which insurance company are you with?
You have to go for an X-ray.
When will the results be ready?
How long will I stay in hospital?
Take this medicine three times a day.

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den, co vás sem přivádí?
dialogue.en: Hello, what brings you here?

dialogue.cz: Dobrý den. Od rána mě hrozně bolí břicho, tady vpravo.
dialogue.en: Hello. Since this morning I've had terrible stomach pain, here on the right.
Do you have your insurance card?

dialogue.cz: Ano, tady je. Jsem u VZP.
dialogue.en: Yes, here it is. I'm with VZP.
Are you allergic to anything?
Yes, to penicillin.

dialogue.cz: Dobře. Lehněte si, prosím. Bolí to tady?
dialogue.en: OK. Lie down, please. Does it hurt here?

dialogue.cz: Au, ano, tam to bolí nejvíc.
dialogue.en: Ow, yes, it hurts most there.

dialogue.cz: Uděláme krevní testy a ultrazvuk. Může to být slepé střevo.
dialogue.en: We'll do blood tests and an ultrasound. It could be appendicitis.
Will I need an operation?

dialogue.cz: Možná. Až budou výsledky, řekneme vám víc. Nic nejezte ani nepijte.
dialogue.en: Maybe. When the results are in, we'll tell you more. Don't eat or drink anything.
I understand. Can I call my wife?
